UPDATE products SET
  discount_percent = CASE
    WHEN expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 0
    WHEN expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 1 THEN 30
    WHEN expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 3 THEN 20
    ELSE 0
  END,
  action = CASE
    WHEN expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED - Remove from shelf'
    WHEN expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 1 THEN 'Apply 30% discount'
    WHEN expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 3 THEN 'Apply 20% discount'
    ELSE 'No action'
  END,
  last_checked = NOW();

SELECT
  COUNT(*)::int AS total,
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE))::int AS expired,
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'product_name', p.product_name,
    'department',   d.name,
    'quantity',     p.quantity,
    'price',        p.price,
    'new_price',    ROUND(p.price * (100 - p.discount_percent) / 100, 2),
    'expiry_date',  p.expiry_date,
    'days_left',    p.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE
  ) ORDER BY p.expiry_date, p.product_name) AS items,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('department', dd.name, 'name', e.full_name) ORDER BY e.full_name)
     FROM employees e
     JOIN departments dd ON dd.id = e.department_id
    WHERE e.role = 'employee' AND e.is_active) AS staff
FROM products p
JOIN departments d ON d.id = p.department_id
WHERE p.expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 3
  AND p.quantity > 0;
